title: Daandeeji Dewondirɗi e Baaɗe Annabi
intro: E nder leydi woɗɗundi, nulaaɗo tedduɗo ina fotnoo salaade no feewi e laamuuji laamuuji oon sahaa. Kono tan cirƴam tokosam e ruuhuuji dewondirɗi ina darii sara oo maccuɗo Alla, ina yiɗi jaabaade noddaango Alla. Goongɗinal maɓɓe ngal ustataako ina fecca leñol doolewol, haa jooni ina fooɗa doole majjere.
clues: Min ngonnoo ko fedde tokosere dewondirnde, denndinnde e iimanaagal e faandaare.
Min ndariima sara nulaaɗo tedduɗo mo laamuuji doole leydi maɓɓe njaɓaani.
Nde oo nelaaɗo naamndii holi wallitooɓe am e laawol Alla? min njaabii tawa min njuumtaani.
En ñaagii oo nulaaɗo nde ɗaɓɓata juulde ummoraade e asamaan ngam addude deeƴre e ɓerɗe men.
E nder yim6e oon yonta, won gooncfin6e e nulal amen won heen kadi 6eydii tiiɗnaare, kono Alla semmbinii googcfin6e.
Minen ko min Hawwariyyun — almuɓɓe Iisaa dewondirɓe, waɗɓe jaalorgal e ballal Alla.

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ كُونُوٓا۟ أَنصَارَ ٱللَّهِ كَمَا قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ لِلْحَوَارِيِّـۧنَ مَنْ أَنصَارِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ قَالَ ٱلْحَوَارِيُّونَ نَحْنُ أَنصَارُ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَـَٔامَنَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنۢ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَكَفَرَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ ۖ فَأَيَّدْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ عَلَىٰ عَدُوِّهِمْ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ ظَـٰهِرِينَ
verse: O you who have believed, be supporters of Allāh, as when Jesus, the son of Mary, said to the disciples, "Who are my supporters for Allāh?" The disciples said, "We are supporters of Allāh." And a faction of the Children of Israel believed and a faction disbelieved. So We supported those who believed against their enemy, and they became dominant. (61:14)
